name: Azeroth Companion
title: Talent Intelligence — Verified IDs & Comparative Research
features: Added click-to-inspect talent source records with Blizzard node, talent and spell IDs, and returned spell descriptions for each available rank or choice.
Added per-node current allocation versus saved-build point deltas, with a concise list of changed talent names and allocations.
Added optional gear lookup by exact Blizzard item ID using the existing protected Cloudflare item endpoint, displaying available item properties and stat fields.
Provided external reference links for official-source spell and item IDs, while explicitly marking unreported stats or talent descriptions as unavailable.
Preserved browser-local saved builds, legacy import/export, all previous studios, existing Worker credentials/API routes and four bundled site resources.
Descriptions and item stats come from Blizzard returned data; no game-valid talent export, live character combat simulation, or DPS estimates are claimed.
